"""Park a subagent child on an approval with RELEASED prism-harness-py code
(v0.5.3), into a file store, so main's code can be tested resuming that exact
shape (G-387 round 3, item 3).

Usage: python -I record_v053_child.py <v0.5.3 src> <output directory>
Offline: sockets refused.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import socket
import sys
from typing import Any


def _refuse(*_a: object, **_k: object) -> None:
    raise AssertionError("network")


socket.socket.connect = _refuse  # type: ignore[method-assign]
socket.create_connection = _refuse  # type: ignore[assignment]

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
directory = sys.argv[2]

from prism_harness import (  # noqa: E402
    AgentRuntime,
    FileSessionStore,
    LlmResponse,
    LlmToolCall,
    ModeRegistry,
    Participant,
    PrismHarness,
    RunBudget,
    RunContext,
    SubagentRunner,
    ToolRegistry,
)

MODES = ModeRegistry(
    {
        "default": "lead",
        "modes": {
            "lead": {
                "system_prompt": "Lead.",
                "tools": ["echo", "worker"],
                "requires_approval": ["echo"],
                "max_steps": 8,
                "subagents": {"worker": {"mode": "work", "max_steps": 2}},
            },
            "work": {
                "system_prompt": "Work.",
                "tools": ["echo", "lookup"],
                "requires_approval": ["echo"],
                "max_steps": 8,
            },
        },
    }
)

script = [
    # the root turn delegates
    LlmResponse(
        text="", finish_reason="tool_calls", tool_calls=[LlmToolCall("c1", "worker", {"task": "go"})]
    ),
    # the child parks on a gated echo
    LlmResponse(
        text="", finish_reason="tool_calls", tool_calls=[LlmToolCall("c2", "echo", {"n": 1})]
    ),
    # the root answers
    LlmResponse(text="Root done.", finish_reason="stop"),
]


def client(_request: Any) -> LlmResponse:
    return script.pop(0)


class Tool:
    def __init__(self, name: str) -> None:
        self.name = name

    def handle(self, args: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
        return "ok"


harness = PrismHarness(
    drivers={"files": lambda: FileSessionStore(directory)},
    stores={"ephemeral": "files", "durable": "files"},
)
runtime: AgentRuntime


def delegate(session: Any) -> Any:
    subagent = MODES.resolve("lead").subagents["worker"]
    return SubagentRunner(harness, runtime).tool(
        subagent, session, RunContext.root("tool-run", RunBudget(100)), "tool-run"
    )


tools = ToolRegistry().register(Tool("echo")).register(Tool("lookup"))
tools.register_factory("worker", delegate)
runtime = AgentRuntime(
    client=client, modes=MODES, tools=tools, config={"provider": "openai", "model": "root-model"}
)
root = harness.for_(Participant("User", "ada")).session("support")
root.using_mode("lead")
response = runtime.send(root, "Go")
child = harness.for_(Participant("User", "ada")).session("support::sub::worker")
rows = [m.message for m in child.thread().messages()]
parked = [r for r in rows if r.get("tool_approval_requests")]
print("root:", response.finish_reason, "child rows:", len(rows), "parked:", len(parked))
print("parked row keys:", sorted(parked[-1].keys()) if parked else None)
